verdict.rationale: The evidence contains nothing on bulk export of a merchant's account data, export formats such as CSV or JSON, or offboarding and data portability. Console reporting and balance reports (truelayer-docs-19, truelayer-docs-20) are an adjacent feature: they do not say the reports are exportable, complete, or in open formats. The Data API reads end users' bank data, not the customer's own TrueLayer data.
